project_type: React SPA with Vite, TypeScript strict mode, Tailwind CSS v4
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build — must pass with no type errors. 2. Run npm run lint — must pass. 3. Run npm test — all existing tests must continue to pass.
environment_constraints: No new npm dependencies without a note in AGENTS.md. TypeScript strict mode — no `any` or type weakening. Colors via CSS tokens only: paper, surface, sunk, hover, line, edge, ink, muted, faint, accent, accent-soft, pink, good, bad, warn. No dark: variants. Tool logic stays in src/tools/, UI in src/components/.
contribution_requirements: Run npm run build and npm run lint before finishing. One component per concern.
key_patterns: Colors: CSS tokens only (no dark: variants). Components: src/components/. Tools: src/tools/. parsePageSelection is exported from src/tools/pdf.ts. renderPageThumbs is in src/lib/pdfThumbs.ts. smallButton CSS class already defined in PdfPageManager.tsx. pagesToPdf builds a PDF from slots. MAX_ARRANGE_PAGES = 300. THUMBS_PER_FILE = 60.
directory_structure: src/components/ — React UI components; src/tools/ — pure tool functions (tested in Node); src/lib/ — shared browser utilities; public/ — static assets
